verdict.rationale: Penpot exposes an MCP server, webhooks, and plugin/API access that let external AI agents or apps trigger design operations, and the runtime probe confirms a real self-hosted MCP handshake works keylessly. However, these are agent-invoked or event-triggered integrations (an agent must actively connect and prompt, or an event must fire a webhook) rather than documented persistent/scheduled automations that run unattended in the background. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/cron-style or continuously-running autonomous jobs, any 'set it and forget it' automation workflow, and independent confirmation that agents operate without live supervision.
